name: Huada Automotive Technology Corp.,Ltd
summary: Huada Automotive Technology Corp.,Ltd manufactures and sells auto parts, fuel vehicle components, and new energy auto parts components in China and internationally. The company manufactures and sells passenger vehicle body parts, related molds, and new energy vehicle battery system components, including battery box trays, motor shafts, motor housings, and energy storage boxes. The company also offers body assembly welded components such as sunroofs, wheel arches, pillars, die-cast series, stamped and drawn parts including heat insulation plates, oil pans, and brackets, as well as metal tubular components like oil dipstick tubes and water hoses.
